question: What is the newly revised official length (in km) of India's coastline?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11098.8 km**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The official length of **India's coastline** has been revised to **11098.8 km** based on updated measurements and assessments.
 
• This revised figure includes the coastlines of the **mainland India** as well as the territories of the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** and **Lakshadweep**.
 
• Earlier estimates of the coastline length were around **7516.6 km**, but the updated measurement incorporates advanced techniques like **geospatial mapping** and **coastal surveys**.
 
• The measurement includes both the **eastern coastline (Bay of Bengal)** and the western coastline (Arabian Sea)</str
